units: <cite ref="Shabbat 26a:4">Sabb. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שהוא עָף</he> because it is volatile (explosive). [<cite ref="Sotah 45a">Sot. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>עפו</he>, <he>עף</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="R00216"><he>צוּף</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Berakhot 63a:21">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>פרנסתו מְעוֹפֶפֶת לו כעוף</he> his sustenance comes flying to him like a bird.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:3">Ḥull. XII, 3</cite> <he>היתה מעופפת</he> if the mother bird was flying about the nest; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 10:10">Tosef. ib. X, 10</cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 4:6">Pirké d’R. El. ch. IV</cite> <he>ובשתים מְעוֹפְפִים וכ׳</he> and with two wings they fly, and they sanctify &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 271">Yalk. Is. 271</cite>; a. e.
